diagnosis: The A-share runtime already had a legitimate child TaskContract.task_id and MarketDayState, while active Skill/UAOS parent state still claimed parent task identity and current-trading-day ownership.

The existing product state machine was strong on point-in-time freeze, U0/U1 recall, U3 execution, review attribution and replay learning, so a generic agent framework rewrite would destroy useful domain specialization.
The previous static_audit.py still loaded physically retired continuity/cutover files and therefore guarded an obsolete control architecture instead of the current repository authority.
Source policy documented Xuangutong and structured market data but did not encode the user's required Tonghuashun/Level-2 assurance priority for A-share microstructure and buyability.
governing_assumptions_rejected: UAOS must create/own a per-day A-share task before domain work can start.
Hosted-runtime promotion status determines who owns A-share business identity.
One generic multi-agent/subtask pattern should define every domain product.
A single market-data provider should be authoritative for all A-share facts.
Parallel/competitive work requires persistent specialist Agents or free-form debate.

external_method_research.source: CFA Institute — Trade Strategy and Execution
external_method_research.finding: Decision quality must consider expected alpha, execution cost/risk and post-trade attribution rather than ranking opportunity alone.
external_method_research.adopted_as: Separate event/market-structure opportunity from execution/buyability evidence and review execution feasibility post-close.

external_method_research.finding: Strategy changes require testing across historical regimes/scenarios and sensitivity rather than one outcome.
external_method_research.adopted_as: Preserve multi-regime frozen replay promotion gate.

external_method_research.finding: Event-driven state and consistent historical/live interfaces reduce look-ahead risk and better approximate actual execution constraints.
external_method_research.adopted_as: Retain deterministic point-in-time MarketDayState/FreezeCard architecture and explicit source/execution events.

acceptance_before_promotion: all existing unit/trajectory tests pass or stale tests are migrated to current ownership semantics without weakening business guards
